ActionName.description: A syntactically valid action name such as `runs.read`.

AuthorizationOutcomeV1.description: Stable authorization outcome. Anything other than an explicit allow is deny.

oneOf.description: Policy explicitly proved the exact request is permitted.
Policy did not prove the exact request is permitted.
An assigned role and all contextual constraints matched.
An active, independently approved emergency grant matched.
Request, resource, or policy organization did not match.
Supplied access records did not belong to the authenticated actor.
Membership, workload identity, or grant was inactive.
No explicit permission matched the request.
A permission matched but its contextual constraints did not.
Policy input or configuration was invalid and failed closed.
Authorization state exceeded the permitted freshness bound.

ContextQualifiedId.description:
A canonical `<context>_<opaque>` reference.

Context names are lowercase ASCII slugs. Opaque components are deliberately
restricted to lowercase base36-compatible text so comparison is stable
across databases, filesystems, and URL encoders.

Purpose.description: A bounded, audit-safe statement of why access is requested.

ResourceRef.description: An opaque, bounded resource reference interpreted by an owning context.

SchemaVersion.description:
A canonical semantic schema version.

Build metadata is forbidden because it is ignored by semantic-version
precedence and would allow distinct envelope identifiers for the same version.

UtcInstant.description:
A canonical RFC 3339 UTC instant.

Only `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z` is accepted. Offsets, spaces, leap
seconds, lowercase separators, and fractional trailing zeroes are rejected so
equal instants have one wire representation. Fractional precision is limited
to nanoseconds.

description: Versioned policy result consumed by downstream application boundaries.

decided_at.description: Canonical instant at which policy made the decision.

organization_id.description: Organization whose policy made the decision.

policy_version.description: Immutable semantic version of the policy snapshot used.

request_id.description: Request to which this decision applies.

resource.description: Exact opaque resource evaluated by policy.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this authorization-decision schema.
